title: Memos & Report Re Labour Statistics

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 2884
24. 11. 31.

November 24, 31.

My dear Hughes,

With reference to your letter of November 19 to
Gerrard on the subject of labour statistics contained
in the Police reports circulated to members of the
Council, every effort will be made in future to make
figures as explicit as possible.

The following explanation of the points raised by
you in respect of the report of November 18 will I trust
clarify matters:-

Bahr & Mathews: The 74 employees of the concern
absented themselves from work without offering any
reason whatsoever and in the event of their remaining
out will within the next few days be replaced by new
hands. Whether these workers struck to rectify a griev-
ance or threw up their employment for good has not been
made clear, and the Special Branch has accordingly re-
frained from classing the case under the category of
"strike".

Tah Hua Hootie Factory. This concern is located
at 363 Yah Sz Leong off Ferry Road, outside the limits
of the Settlement.

Dah Tung Printing Press, 8 North Peking Road. Here
there are 160 employees on strike.

Actually there were only two strikes recorded on
this date (November 18), i.e.

1012.

文书与统计处登记室
S. B. D. 2884
31年11月24日

1931年11月24日。

亲爱的休斯：

关于你11月19日致杰拉德（Gerrard）的信件，信中提及分发给各位董事的警务报告中所载的劳工统计数据一事，今后我们将尽一切努力使数据尽可能明确。

针对你在有关11月18日报告中提出的几点疑问，以下解释希望能澄清事实：

贝尔和马修斯公司（Bahr & Mathews）：该公司74名雇员无故缺勤，若他们持续旷工，将在未来几天内由新员工替代。目前尚不清楚这些工人是为了纠正不满而罢工，还是彻底放弃了工作，因此特别处未将此案归类为“罢工”。

大华领带厂（Tah Hua Hootie Factory）。该企业位于租界以外，渡轮路（Ferry Road）旁的亚士龙路（Yah Sz Leong）363号。

大通印刷所（Dah Tung Printing Press），北平路8号。此处有160名员工罢工。

实际上，在该日期（11月18日）记录的罢工仅有两起，即

1012.

(Sd) R.A.J. Martin.

CHINA UNITED
ASSURANCE SOCIETY, LIMITED.
SHEET NO 1
DATE NOV. 19, 1931

C. D. D. 2804
24. 11. 31.

Major F. W. Gerrard, C.I.E.,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Personal

My dear Major:

I have been trying to find an opportunity
to drop in and welcome you back to Shanghai. I trust that
you had a very enjoyable holiday and that you have returned
physically fit to meet the strenuous conditions which we
have now to face.

There is a matter of trifling importance
that I would like to bring to your attention in connection
with the Police reports circulated to members of the
Council. I have noticed in almost every report a discrepancy
between the aggregate number of employees on strike, as
detailed in the reports, and the number given as on strike
in the Settlement in the summary of strike statistics.

For example, in the report received this
morning, there are 74 employees of Behr & Mathews who are on
strike; 160 employees of the Dah Tung Printing Press; and
200 of the Tah Hwa Necktie Factory; making a total of 434,
whilst the summary gives a total of only 160.
Summary shows
total 434
AR

Although of no material importance, these
discrepancies have been a matter of comment at a recent
Council meeting. There probably is some simple explanation
and it might be worth your while to refer to it.

Yours sincerely,

A. J. Hughes.

P.S. I mention this matter in no
spirit of carping criticism. I am
very proud of our Police Dept. and its
reports as circulated to Council members
reflect efficiency of administration
beyond praise. You may have read the
manuscript of the Chinese Republics
Acts recently published. If you may
be interested in the enclosed Copy of a
letter to the Chairman & Secy. General which
I enclose for your private information. (A)

AJH:MW
SI,

please. The
explanation should
also be given in
the D. G. Summary

F. W. 杰拉德少校，C.I.E.勋衔，
上海公共租界警务处，
上海。

私人信件

亲爱的少校：

我一直想找机会登门拜访，欢迎您回到上海。我相信您度过了一个非常愉快的假期，并且身体康健地归来，以应对我们目前必须面对的严峻局势。

有一件微不足道的小事，我想提请阁下注意，这与分发给各位董事的警务报告有关。我注意到，几乎每份报告中，详细列出的罢工员工总数与罢工统计摘要中给出的租界内罢工人数之间存在差异。

例如，在今早收到的报告中，贝尔和马修斯公司（Behr & Mathews）有74名员工罢工；大通印刷所有160名员工；大华领带厂有200名员工；总计434人，而摘要中给出的总数仅为160人。
摘要显示
总数 434
AR

虽然这并无实质重要性，但这些差异在最近的一次董事会议上已成为议论的话题。这可能有一个简单的解释，或许值得您过问此事。

此致，

A. J. 休斯。

附言：我提及此事绝非出于吹毛求疵的批评。我为我们的警务处深感自豪，其分发给董事们的报告所反映出的行政效率无可挑剔。您可能已经阅读了最近出版的《中华民国法令》手稿。如果您感兴趣，随信附上我致主席兼总秘书的一封信的副本，供您私下参考。(A)

AJH:MW
SI，
请予评论。
该解释也应
出现在总监摘要中
G.P. 31年11月23日

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
File No.
S. B. D. 2884
S. 1 Station,
Date November 10 1931.）

Subject (in full) Refugees.

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Robertson

With reference to the letter of November 2, 1931 from
Captain Field regarding statistics of refugees as contained
in the Special Branch Intelligence Summary I have to state
that the number of refugees arriving at Shanghai is given
as the total of persons observed to land and not necessarily
residing in this area.
The number given of persons repatriated is treated
separately and is not deducted from the number of arrivals
for the following reasons.
Refugees on arrival, with the exception of a comparati-
vely small number accommodated at the Liu Ying Road Camp,
distribute themselves throughout Chinese controlled territory
and surrounding country districts and it is possible that
many hundreds of them have returned to their homes without
passing through the Settlement. It would not therefore
be a fair calculation to deduct the number repatriated from
the number of arrivals. Moreover, under present arrange-
ments the Liu Ying Road Camp will close at the end of the
current month which does not mean that the influx nor the
departure of refugees will cease.

Henry Robertson
C. D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
（签名）

日期 1931年11月10日。）

主题（全称） 难民。

制作人及转发人 C.D.I. 罗伯逊

关于菲尔德上尉1931年11月2日来信，信中提及特别处情报摘要中所载的难民统计数据，本人须说明，抵达上海的难民人数系指观察到的登陆人员总数，并不一定是在本区域居住的人员。
遣返人员数目单独计算，不从未抵人数中扣除，原因如下。
难民抵达后，除少数人安置在刘英路营地外，其余分散在中国管辖区域及周边乡村地区，其中可能有数百人并未经过租界便已返回家园。因此，从抵达人数中减去遣返人数并非公平的计算方法。此外，根据目前的安排，刘英路营地将于本月月底关闭，但这并不意味着难民的涌入或离开将会停止。

亨利·罗伯逊
C. D. I.

特别处主管警官。
（签名）

9, Hongkong Road,
9/11/31.
-----------------

Dear Givens,

May I draw your attention to what looks like an error
in the daily summary of information ?

The report of Nov.7th gives the total number of refugees
in Shanghai as 65,133.
The report of Nov.9th states that, on the 7th and 8th,
400 refugees were repatriated, while on the same dates 333
arrived.

This leaves a balance in favour of repatriation of 67,
and the total number of refugees on November 8th should
therefore be 65066.
Instead of this, the total is given in to-day's report
as 65,466, which figure looks as if it was arrived at by
adding the arrivals of the 7th and 8th to the total for
the 6th, without taking account of the departures.

May I suggest that, if this practice has been going on
ever since repatriation began, the total number of refugees in
Shanghai should now read 62,686, which is arrived at by
taking the total in to-day's report and deducting from it
the total number of people repatriated ?

Yours,
L. Field

T.P. Givens, Esq:,
A/C.P. (Special Branch), Shanghai Municipal Police.

香港路9号，
31年11月9日。
-----------------

亲爱的吉文斯：

能否提请阁下注意每日情报摘要中看似存在的一处错误？

11月7日的报告给出上海的难民总数为65,133人。
11月9日的报告指出，7日和8日两天有400名难民被遣返，而在同两天内有333人抵达。

这使得遣返人数多出67人，因此11月8日的难民总数应为65,066人。
然而，今天的报告中给出的总数却是65,466人，这个数字看起来像是将7日和8日的抵达人数加到了6日的总数上，而未考虑离开的人数。

我建议，如果自遣返开始以来一直沿用这种做法，那么上海目前的难民总数应修正为62,686人，这是通过从今天报告中的总数中减去已遣返人员总数得出的？

此致，
L. 菲尔德

T.P. 吉文斯 先生，
代理助理警司（特别处），上海公共租界警务处。
